subject_group: 6.1.10 Vertical/short takeoff and landing air vehicles

versions.text: Criterion: Verify that V/STOL ground handling is safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.7.1.7 Ground handling. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, design, test, or configuration documentation.

Standard: The air vehicle is no worse than Level 2 flying qualities for V/STOL-configured ground handling. For conventional mode operations, see the other relevant standards in 6.1. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis of all V/STOL ground handling to evaluate air vehicle capabilities to include: a. Vehicle configured following powered-lift landings or VLs. b. Vehicle configured for planned takeoff. c. Vehicle configured for powered-lift taxiing. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess ground handling qualities as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Ground Handling paragraph for each combination of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions, to include: a. Vehicle configured following powered-lift landings or VLs. b. Vehicle configured for planned takeoff. c. Vehicle configured for powered-lift taxiing. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess ground handling qualities as specified in MIL-STD- 1797, Ground Handling paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions, to include: a. Vehicle configured following powered-lift landings or VLs. b. Vehicle configured for planned takeoff. c. Vehicle configured for powered-lift taxiing.
